module Splice.Scripts.Wallet.TestTransferOffers where

import DA.Assert
import DA.Time
import Daml.Script

import Splice.Amulet
import Splice.AmuletRules
import Splice.Wallet.Install
import Splice.Wallet.Payment

import Splice.Scripts.Util

testTransferOffers : Script ()
testTransferOffers = script do
  DefaultAppWithUsers{..} <- setupDefaultAppWithUsers
  runNextIssuance app
  runAmuletDepositBots app

  tap app alice 15.0

  t <- getTime
  aliceInstall <- submitMulti [alice.primaryParty, aliceValidator.primaryParty] [] $ createCmd $ WalletAppInstall with
    endUserParty = alice.primaryParty
    endUserName = "alice"
    dsoParty = app.dso
    validatorParty = aliceValidator.primaryParty

  bobInstall <- submitMulti [bob.primaryParty, bobValidator.primaryParty] [] $ createCmd $ WalletAppInstall with
    endUserParty = bob.primaryParty
    endUserName = "bob"
    dsoParty = app.dso
    validatorParty = bobValidator.primaryParty

  let createOffer amount description curTime trackingId = do
      createResult <-submitMulti [aliceValidator.primaryParty] [alice.primaryParty] $ exerciseCmd aliceInstall
            WalletAppInstall_CreateTransferOffer with
                  receiver = bob.primaryParty
                  amount = PaymentAmount amount AmuletUnit
                  description = description
                  expiresAt = curTime `addRelTime` minutes 5
                  trackingId = trackingId
      return createResult.transferOffer

-- TODO(#2957): remove read-as DSO party.
  let completeTransfer accepted amulet transferContext = submitMulti [aliceValidator.primaryParty] [alice.primaryParty, aliceValidator.primaryParty, app.dso] $ exerciseCmd aliceInstall WalletAppInstall_ExecuteBatch with
        inputs = [InputAmulet amulet]
        operations = [CO_CompleteAcceptedTransfer accepted]
        context = transferContext

  offer <- createOffer 2.0 " transfer test" t "transfer_test"
  acceptResult <- submitMulti [bobValidator.primaryParty] [bob.primaryParty] $ exerciseCmd bobInstall
        WalletAppInstall_TransferOffer_Accept with cid = offer
  let accepted = acceptResult.acceptedTransferOffer
  [(amulet, _)] <- queryFilter @Amulet alice.primaryParty (\c -> c.amount.initialAmount > 2.5)
  transferContext <- getPaymentTransferContext app alice
  _ <- completeTransfer accepted amulet transferContext

  offer <- createOffer 3.0 "to be rejected" t "to_be_rejected"
  submitMulti [bobValidator.primaryParty] [bob.primaryParty] $ exerciseCmd bobInstall WalletAppInstall_TransferOffer_Reject with cid = offer

  offer <- createOffer 4.0 "to be withdrawn" t "to_be_withdrawn"
  submitMulti [aliceValidator.primaryParty] [alice.primaryParty] $ exerciseCmd aliceInstall WalletAppInstall_TransferOffer_Withdraw with cid = offer, reason = "test withdraw"

  offer <- createOffer 7.0 "To expire" t "to_expire"
  passTime (minutes 6)
  [_] <- queryFilter @Amulet alice.primaryParty (\c -> c.amount.initialAmount > 7.5)
  submitMultiMustFail [bobValidator.primaryParty] [bob.primaryParty] $ exerciseCmd bobInstall
        WalletAppInstall_TransferOffer_Accept with cid = offer

  t <- getTime
  offer <- createOffer 8.0 "To abort post-acceptance" t "to_abort"
  acceptResult <- submitMulti [bobValidator.primaryParty] [bob.primaryParty] $ exerciseCmd bobInstall
        WalletAppInstall_TransferOffer_Accept with cid = offer
  let accepted = acceptResult.acceptedTransferOffer
  submitMulti [aliceValidator.primaryParty] [alice.primaryParty] $ exerciseCmd aliceInstall
        WalletAppInstall_AcceptedTransferOffer_Abort with
          cid = accepted
          reason = "test abort"

  offer <- createOffer 8.5 "To withdraw acceptance" t "to_withdraw_acceptance"
  acceptResult <- submitMulti [bobValidator.primaryParty] [bob.primaryParty] $ exerciseCmd bobInstall
        WalletAppInstall_TransferOffer_Accept with cid = offer
  let accepted = acceptResult.acceptedTransferOffer
  submitMulti [bobValidator.primaryParty] [bob.primaryParty] $ exerciseCmd bobInstall
        WalletAppInstall_AcceptedTransferOffer_Withdraw with
          cid = accepted
          reason = "test withdraw accepted"

  t <- getTime
  offer <- createOffer 100.0 "Insufficient funds" t "insufficient_funds"
  accept <- submitMulti [bobValidator.primaryParty] [bob.primaryParty] $ exerciseCmd bobInstall
        WalletAppInstall_TransferOffer_Accept with cid = offer
  let accepted = accept.acceptedTransferOffer
  transferContext <- getPaymentTransferContext app alice
  [(amulet, _)] <- queryFilter @Amulet alice.primaryParty (\c -> c.amount.initialAmount > 1.0)
  WalletAppInstall_ExecuteBatchResult { outcomes } <- completeTransfer accepted amulet transferContext
  [COO_Error _] <- pure outcomes
  -- tap more amulet and retry the transfer
  aliceAmuletsBefore <- query @Amulet alice.primaryParty
  tap app alice 101.05  -- chosen such that all amulets of alice are consumed
  [(amulet, _)] <- queryFilter @Amulet alice.primaryParty (\c -> c.amount.initialAmount > 100.0)
  WalletAppInstall_ExecuteBatchResult { outcomes } <- completeTransfer accepted amulet transferContext
  trace outcomes $ pure ()
  [COO_CompleteAcceptedTransfer _] <- pure outcomes

  aliceAmuletsAfter <- query @Amulet alice.primaryParty
  aliceAmuletsAfter === aliceAmuletsBefore -- no sender change was created

  pure ()

import Splice.Wallet.TransferOffer

makeOffer : Party -> Party -> Party -> Time -> Script (ContractId TransferOffer)
makeOffer sender receiver dso expiresAt =
  submit sender $ createCmd TransferOffer with
    sender
    receiver
    dso
    amount = PaymentAmount 12.0 AmuletUnit
    description = "test transfer"
    expiresAt
    trackingId = "offer-123"

testTransferOfferAccept : Script ()
testTransferOfferAccept = script do
  sender <- allocateParty "sender"
  receiver <- allocateParty "receiver"
  outsider <- allocateParty "outsider"
  now <- getTime
  offer <- makeOffer sender receiver outsider (now `addRelTime` minutes 5)
  submitMustFail sender $ exerciseCmd offer TransferOffer_Accept
  submitMustFail outsider $ exerciseCmd offer TransferOffer_Accept
  TransferOffer_AcceptResult accepted <- submit receiver $ exerciseCmd offer TransferOffer_Accept
  Some details <- queryContractId sender accepted
  details.sender === sender
  details.receiver === receiver
  details.dso === outsider
  details.amount === PaymentAmount 12.0 AmuletUnit
  details.expiresAt === now `addRelTime` minutes 5
  details.trackingId === "offer-123"
  None <- queryContractId sender offer
  pure ()

testTransferOfferRejectAndWithdraw : Script ()
testTransferOfferRejectAndWithdraw = script do
  sender <- allocateParty "sender"
  receiver <- allocateParty "receiver"
  outsider <- allocateParty "outsider"
  now <- getTime
  let expected = TransferOfferTrackingInfo "offer-123" sender receiver
  rejected <- makeOffer sender receiver outsider (now `addRelTime` minutes 5)
  submitMustFail sender $ exerciseCmd rejected TransferOffer_Reject
  TransferOffer_RejectResult rejectedInfo <- submit receiver $ exerciseCmd rejected TransferOffer_Reject
  rejectedInfo === expected
  None <- queryContractId sender rejected
  withdrawn <- makeOffer sender receiver outsider (now `addRelTime` minutes 5)
  submitMustFail receiver $ exerciseCmd withdrawn TransferOffer_Withdraw with reason = "changed mind"
  TransferOffer_WithdrawResult withdrawnInfo <- submit sender $ exerciseCmd withdrawn TransferOffer_Withdraw with reason = "changed mind"
  withdrawnInfo === expected
  None <- queryContractId sender withdrawn
  pure ()

testAcceptedTransferOfferCancellation : Script ()
testAcceptedTransferOfferCancellation = script do
  sender <- allocateParty "sender"
  receiver <- allocateParty "receiver"
  outsider <- allocateParty "outsider"
  now <- getTime
  let expiresAt = now `addRelTime` minutes 5
  let expected = TransferOfferTrackingInfo "offer-123" sender receiver
  first <- makeOffer sender receiver outsider expiresAt
  TransferOffer_AcceptResult acceptedForWithdraw <- submit receiver $ exerciseCmd first TransferOffer_Accept
  submitMustFail sender $ exerciseCmd acceptedForWithdraw AcceptedTransferOffer_Withdraw with reason = "no"
  AcceptedTransferOffer_WithdrawResult withdrawn <- submit receiver $ exerciseCmd acceptedForWithdraw AcceptedTransferOffer_Withdraw with reason = "no"
  withdrawn === expected
  None <- queryContractId sender acceptedForWithdraw
  second <- makeOffer sender receiver outsider expiresAt
  TransferOffer_AcceptResult acceptedForAbort <- submit receiver $ exerciseCmd second TransferOffer_Accept
  submitMustFail receiver $ exerciseCmd acceptedForAbort AcceptedTransferOffer_Abort with reason = "no"
  AcceptedTransferOffer_AbortResult aborted <- submit sender $ exerciseCmd acceptedForAbort AcceptedTransferOffer_Abort with reason = "no"
  aborted === expected
  None <- queryContractId receiver acceptedForAbort
  pure ()

testTransferOfferExpiry : Script ()
testTransferOfferExpiry = script do
  sender <- allocateParty "sender"
  receiver <- allocateParty "receiver"
  outsider <- allocateParty "outsider"
  now <- getTime
  let expiresAt = now `addRelTime` minutes 5
  let expected = TransferOfferTrackingInfo "offer-123" sender receiver
  offer <- makeOffer sender receiver outsider expiresAt
  submitMustFail sender $ exerciseCmd offer TransferOffer_Expire with actor = sender
  submitMustFail receiver $ exerciseCmd offer TransferOffer_Expire with actor = receiver
  acceptedOffer <- makeOffer sender receiver outsider expiresAt
  TransferOffer_AcceptResult accepted <- submit receiver $ exerciseCmd acceptedOffer TransferOffer_Accept
  submitMustFail sender $ exerciseCmd accepted AcceptedTransferOffer_Expire with actor = sender
  passTime (minutes 5)
  submitMustFail receiver $ exerciseCmd offer TransferOffer_Accept
  submitMultiMustFail [outsider] [sender, receiver] $ exerciseCmd offer TransferOffer_Expire with actor = outsider
  TransferOffer_ExpireResult expired <- submit receiver $ exerciseCmd offer TransferOffer_Expire with actor = receiver
  expired === expected
  None <- queryContractId sender offer
  submitMultiMustFail [outsider] [sender, receiver] $ exerciseCmd accepted AcceptedTransferOffer_Expire with actor = outsider
  AcceptedTransferOffer_ExpireResult acceptedExpired <- submit sender $ exerciseCmd accepted AcceptedTransferOffer_Expire with actor = sender
  acceptedExpired === expected
  None <- queryContractId receiver accepted
  pure ()

testTransferOfferFieldLimits : Script ()
testTransferOfferFieldLimits = script do
  sender <- allocateParty "sender"
  receiver <- allocateParty "receiver"
  now <- getTime
  let shortText = foldl (<>) "" (replicate 279 "x")
  let longText = shortText <> "x"
  _ <- submit sender $ createCmd TransferOffer with
    sender
    receiver
    dso = sender
    amount = PaymentAmount 1.0 AmuletUnit
    description = shortText
    expiresAt = now
    trackingId = shortText
  submitMustFail sender $ createCmd TransferOffer with
    sender
    receiver
    dso = sender
    amount = PaymentAmount 1.0 AmuletUnit
    description = longText
    expiresAt = now
    trackingId = "valid"
  submitMustFail sender $ createCmd TransferOffer with
    sender
    receiver
    dso = sender
    amount = PaymentAmount 1.0 AmuletUnit
    description = "valid"
    expiresAt = now
    trackingId = longText
  pure ()

testCompleteAcceptedTransferOffer : Script ()
testCompleteAcceptedTransferOffer = script do
  DefaultAppWithUsers{..} <- setupDefaultAppWithUsers
  runNextIssuance app
  runAmuletDepositBots app
  amulet <- tap app alice 42.0
  now <- getTime
  let sender = alice.primaryParty
  let receiver = bob.primaryParty
  offer <- makeOffer sender receiver app.dso (now `addRelTime` minutes 5)
  TransferOffer_AcceptResult accepted <- submit receiver $ exerciseCmd offer TransferOffer_Accept
  transferContext <- getPaymentTransferContext app alice
  let walletProvider = aliceValidator.primaryParty
  submitMultiMustFail [sender] [app.dso] $ exerciseCmd accepted AcceptedTransferOffer_Complete with
    inputs = [InputAmulet amulet]
    transferContext
    walletProvider
  AcceptedTransferOffer_CompleteResult{..} <- submitMulti [sender, walletProvider] [app.dso] $ exerciseCmd accepted AcceptedTransferOffer_Complete with
    inputs = [InputAmulet amulet]
    transferContext
    walletProvider
  trackingInfo === TransferOfferTrackingInfo "offer-123" sender receiver
  senderChangeAmulet === transferResult.senderChangeAmulet
  [(_, receiverAmulet)] <- queryFilter @Amulet receiver (\amulet -> amulet.amount.initialAmount == 12.0)
  receiverAmulet.amount.initialAmount === 12.0
  None <- queryContractId sender accepted
  nextOffer <- makeOffer sender receiver app.dso (now `addRelTime` minutes 5)
  TransferOffer_AcceptResult nextAccepted <- submit receiver $ exerciseCmd nextOffer TransferOffer_Accept
  passTime (minutes 5)
  let Some changeAmulet = senderChangeAmulet
  submitMultiMustFail [sender, walletProvider] [app.dso] $ exerciseCmd nextAccepted AcceptedTransferOffer_Complete with
    inputs = [InputAmulet changeAmulet]
    transferContext
    walletProvider
  pure ()

testExpiredOffersCanBeCancelled : Script ()
testExpiredOffersCanBeCancelled = script do
  sender <- allocateParty "sender"
  receiver <- allocateParty "receiver"
  now <- getTime
  let expected = TransferOfferTrackingInfo "offer-123" sender receiver
  rejected <- makeOffer sender receiver sender now
  withdrawn <- makeOffer sender receiver sender now
  toAbort <- makeOffer sender receiver sender (now `addRelTime` minutes 1)
  toWithdraw <- makeOffer sender receiver sender (now `addRelTime` minutes 1)

  TransferOffer_AcceptResult acceptedToWithdraw <- submit receiver $ exerciseCmd toWithdraw TransferOffer_Accept
  passTime (minutes 1)
  TransferOffer_RejectResult rejectInfo <- submit receiver $ exerciseCmd rejected TransferOffer_Reject
  rejectInfo === expected
  TransferOffer_WithdrawResult withdrawInfo <- submit sender $ exerciseCmd withdrawn TransferOffer_Withdraw with reason = "expired"
  withdrawInfo === expected
  AcceptedTransferOffer_AbortResult abortInfo <- submit sender $ exerciseCmd acceptedToAbort AcceptedTransferOffer_Abort with reason = "expired"
  abortInfo === expected
  AcceptedTransferOffer_WithdrawResult acceptedWithdrawInfo <- submit receiver $ exerciseCmd acceptedToWithdraw AcceptedTransferOffer_Withdraw with reason = "expired"
  acceptedWithdrawInfo === expected
  pure ()
